title: 外倾低位慢下撤
description: 孔版印刷展现浅外倾低位下撤，鞋尖指向清楚的下一脚点。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration depicts a fictional adult downclimbing a low shallow-overhang route with deliberate control. One shoe lowers toward a broad foothold near the continuous crash mat, while the other foot and both hands retain secure positive contacts. The body remains close to the panel with no cut-loose swing. Compose a wide three-quarter scene showing the entire opaque-clothed adult, modest wall angle, compact blue hold line, and generous empty padded landing. Layer warm pink, cobalt, and cream inks with visible print grain. Keep adult anatomy and hand orientation credible. Include no words, brands, falling, leaps, dangerous height, or people beneath the route.
